levels.name: REGISTERED
levels.definition: Canonical capability identity and owner are registered.

levels.name: CONTRACTED
levels.definition: Capability contract/schema and boundary are explicit.

levels.name: DETERMINISTIC
levels.definition: Applicable deterministic behavior is implemented and repeatable.

levels.name: FIXTURE_VALIDATED
levels.definition: Applicable reference/edge/regression fixtures are bound to the capability.

levels.name: INTEGRATED
levels.definition: Capability is integrated with its declared upstream/downstream handoffs.

levels.name: PRODUCTION_BOUND
levels.definition: A governed production boundary or production adapter exists for the exact scope.

levels.name: REPORT_CAPABLE
levels.definition: Capability can produce or hand off governed report content where report semantics apply.

levels.name: OBSERVABLE
levels.definition: Operational state/drift/health is observable where observability applies.

levels.name: RECOVERABLE
levels.definition: Governed incident/replay/recovery behavior is implemented where recovery applies.
